name: xdeck
description: XDeck Chrome extension: multi-column deck for X. No build step; load the folder unpacked.

scripts.test: node tools/check-package.mjs && node tests/columns.test.mjs && node tests/collections.test.mjs && node tests/core.test.mjs && node tests/e2e.test.mjs
scripts.zip: zip -r xdeck.zip manifest.json background.js deck.css src content icons -x '*.DS_Store'
